decisions.reason: As a low-visibility component that disappeared from the website and is not central to the firm's publicly stressed move toward broader low-carbon system solutions, it creates too little commitment pressure to keep backing.

Although it had its own page at launch, the electric infrared panel heater was quickly removed from view and sits only loosely within the firm's core customized industrial climate-systems proposition, so management would reallocate resources rather than defend it further.

The electric halogen infrared heater showed the same pattern of brief promotion followed by disappearance, and with limited strategic centrality and weakened public commitment it is easier to abandon despite the development effort already spent.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater should be retained because the firm has invested in it, publicly celebrated it as an innovative breakthrough, and tied it directly to its announced lower-carbon and hydrogen-ready strategic direction.
